gloss: Review how a success metric changes behaviour and what valuable work it fails to count
mechanism: When a {{metric}} is used to judge work, it is reviewed on a stated schedule for two things: behaviour that has shifted to raise the measure without serving the goal, and valuable activity the measure does not count. Findings are recorded with the metric.
invariants: The metric is reviewed on a stated schedule.
Each review records observed gaming and valuable activity the metric misses.
failure_modes: Goodhart drift: work optimises the measure, not the goal.
Mirror blindness: reviews look only at the measure and so find nothing.
